# Anne Shirley & Lavendar Lewis

- [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) — Friend of — [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) — very dear friend and kindred spirit · since v2  <sub>[v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P31](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0031)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> At school, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) gets into a dispute over a picture drawn on a slate, while [Dora](../character/dora.md) becomes frightened of staying in the dark after [Mirabel Cotton](../character/mirabel-cotton.md) shares stories of her family's ghosts. Later in October, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) get lost in the woods on their way to a tea party and stumble upon [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). There they meet the eccentric Miss Lavendar [Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and her maid [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), who invite them to stay for tea.
>
> — v2 · XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P1](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0001), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P49](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0049)_

> Miss Lavendar entertains [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and Charlotta the Fourth with tea and demonstrates the magical echoes around [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). After explaining the history of her succession of 'Charlottas,' Miss Lavendar is shaken when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) casually mentions [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), the son of her former lover, [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md). The girls bid a warm farewell to a visibly saddened Miss Lavendar and reflect on her and their own names as they leave.
>
> — v2 · XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P64](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0064), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P71](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0071), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P81](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0081), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P87](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0087)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) walks through the woods to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) to spend an evening with Miss Lavendar while Charlotta the Fourth is away. Over tea and candy, Miss Lavendar confides in [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about her past romance and broken engagement with [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md). A month later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) brings Stephen's son, [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), to meet Miss Lavendar, and the two quickly bond.
>
> — v2 · XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance

_Sources: [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P4](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0004), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P10](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0010), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P15](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0015), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P26](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0026)_
